title: Languages Still Left Behind: Toward a Better Multilingual Machine Translation Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative human re-evaluation by native speakers to identify lexical gaps, domain-specific jargon, and English-centric concepts (e.g., seasons, Western sports terms) that lack natural equivalents or do not exist in the target cultures.

Quantitative evaluation comparing machine translation model performance on an English-centric benchmark (FLORES+) against naturalistic, community-sourced datasets, and testing automated metrics (BLEU, ChrF++) using dummy translations composed solely of copied named entities.
